tasks.subject: Task 1: Fuzzy matching utility
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `src/lib/csv/fuzzy.ts` — a pure, dependency-free Levenshtein-based best-match function — with full test coverage.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/csv/fuzzy.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/csv/fuzzy.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `bestMatch(query, candidates)` returns closest candidate when distance ≤ 2 AND ratio ≤ 30%
- [ ] Returns `null` when no candidate meets the threshold
- [ ] Case-insensitive; returned value preserves original candidate casing
- [ ] All tests pass

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/lib/csv/fuzzy.test.ts` → all tests green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/csv/fuzzy.ts", "src/lib/csv/fuzzy.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/csv/fuzzy.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bestMatch returns closest candidate when distance ≤ 2 AND ratio ≤ 30%", "Returns null when no candidate meets threshold", "Case-insensitive matching", "All tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Update validator — hard vs soft error types
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update `src/lib/csv/validate-components.ts` so that `error` is a structured object `{ message, type, field? }` instead of a plain string, with supplier/group mismatches returning `type: "soft"` and everything else returning `type: "hard"`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/csv/validate-components.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/csv/validate-components.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ValidatedRow.error` is `{ message: string; type: "hard" | "soft"; field?: string }` or undefined
- [ ] Supplier-not-found → `type: "soft"`, `field: "supplier_name"`
- [ ] Group-not-found → `type: "soft"`, `field: "group_name"`
- [ ] All other errors → `type: "hard"`, no `field`
- [ ] All tests pass

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/lib/csv/validate-components.test.ts` → all tests green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/csv/validate-components.ts", "src/lib/csv/validate-components.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/csv/validate-components.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["error.type is hard or soft", "supplier/group not-found are soft", "location not-found is hard", "all tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Update components import API route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update `src/app/api/import/components/route.ts` so the dry-run response includes `unknowns` (with fuzzy suggestions) and `allSuppliers`/`allGroups`; the commit path accepts `resolutions`, creates new suppliers/groups, and merges resolved IDs before inserting.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/api/import/components/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Dry-run response includes `unknowns.suppliers`, `unknowns.groups`, `allSuppliers`, `allGroups`
- [ ] Fuzzy suggestions computed via `bestMatch`
- [ ] Commit with complete resolutions succeeds
- [ ] Commit with missing resolutions returns 400
- [ ] Commit with hard errors returns 400 regardless
- [ ] `create_new` resolutions create the DB record before inserting components

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/import/components/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dry-run returns unknowns+suggestions+allSuppliers+allGroups", "commit accepts resolutions", "create_new creates DB records", "missing resolutions return 400"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Update import UI — Preview changes, Resolve step, CSS
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update `src/app/app/components/import/page.tsx` and `src/app/app/_ui/import-page.module.css` to implement the 4-step wizard with amber soft-mismatch warnings in Preview and a new Resolve step.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/import/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/_ui/import-page.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Wizard bar shows 4 steps: Upload / Preview / Resolve / Done
- [ ] Soft-mismatch rows show amber warning (not red)
- [ ] Preview: only soft mismatches → "Next: Resolve →"; hard errors → re-upload only; clean → Import
- [ ] Resolve step: fuzzy suggestion chip, pick-existing dropdown, create-new with editable name
- [ ] Resolved values show green chip with undo
- [ ] Import button disabled until all unknowns resolved
- [ ] `resolutions` JSON sent in FormData on commit

**Verify:** Manual: upload CSV with typo'd supplier → see amber warning → Resolve step → "Did you mean X?" → accept → import succeeds

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/import/page.tsx", "src/app/app/_ui/import-page.module.css"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["4-step wizard", "amber soft-mismatch warnings", "Resolve step with suggestion/pick/create", "resolutions sent on commit"]}
```
